name: daily-mobility-generation-benchmark
description: A benchmark for generative models of daily human mobility patterns, composed of trajectory and contextual data to evaluate how well models can produce realistic daily movement sequences. It measures fidelity, diversity, and utility of generated mobility traces for downstream tasks such as forecasting and simulation. The dataset supports conditional generation given context (time, start location, user attributes) and can be used to evaluate both probabilistic and deterministic generation methods.
evaluation_method: ADE/FDE (Average / Final Displacement Error), trajectory likelihood
reputation: A niche, research-focused dataset hosted on Hugging Face from a Tsinghua group; recognized in mobility/trajectory generation research but not yet widely adopted.
